name: std::generator<Ref,V,Allocator>::promise_type::operator delete

declarations.code: void operator delete(void *ptr, std::size_t n) noexcept;

intro:
Deallocates the storage pointed to by ptr using an allocator equivalent to that used to allocate this memory.

The ptr passed to this function must be the one returned from an invocation of one of the operator new overloads with a size argument equal to n. Otherwise the behavior is undefined.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
ptr

 -

 a pointer obtained from the previous call to operator new


 n

 -

 the size of the storage to be deallocated

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Yield two values, transfer ownership, and propagate an exception. Requires a conforming generator implementation; libstdc++ 14.2 has a missing return in its move-assignment implementation.
